name: mr-winds
description: Ranks kite, windsurf, wing foil, surf and sailing spots and marinas on the live forecast.

interface.shortDescription: Where to kite, surf or sail
interface.longDescription:
MR. WINDS tells you where to go kitesurfing, windsurfing, wing foiling, surfing, sailing or boating today, tomorrow or this weekend. It ranks kite, windsurf and wing foil spots, surf spots and marinas worldwide on the live wind, waves, swell period and weather forecast and on your door-to-door travel time by car or train, then gives the best spots with a score out of 100, the reasons, wind speed and direction, wave height, the best day in the next 7 days and a link to the live spot page.

Activities: kitesurfing, windsurfing, wing foiling, surfing, sailing, boating and marinas.

It also finds places to stay near a spot with the lowest price per night seen for your dates. Read-only, no account, no login.
defaultPrompt: Where can I kitesurf this weekend within 6 hours of Lyon?
What are the wind and waves in Tarifa tomorrow?
Is Saturday a good day to sail out of La Trinité-sur-Mer?

positive.prompt: Where can I kitesurf this weekend within 6 hours of Lyon?
positive.expected_behavior: Kite spots reachable within 6 hours of Lyon for next weekend, ranked with a score out of 100, wind speed and direction, travel time and links to the spot pages.

positive.prompt: Best surf spot within 5 hours of Paris on Saturday?
positive.expected_behavior: Surf spots within 5 hours of Paris ranked for Saturday with wave height and period, wind, travel time and links.

positive.prompt: What are the wind and waves in Tarifa tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: Tomorrow's wind speed and direction, wave height and period, the best day in the next 7 days, sea temperature when known, and the Tarifa spot link.

positive.prompt: Is Saturday a good day to sail out of La Trinité-sur-Mer?
positive.expected_behavior: Wind speed and direction, wave height and sea temperature for the Port de la Trinité sur Mer marina, with the marina page link.

positive.description: Places to stay near a spot
positive.prompt: Find a place to stay near Leucate for 2 adults next weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Places to stay near Leucate for next Friday to Sunday with the lowest price per night seen, cheapest first, and a link to compare and book.

negative.prompt: Book the Hotel Alpina in Zermatt for me and pay with my credit card.

negative.description: City commute weather, not an outdoor destination
negative.prompt: Will it rain on my commute in central London tomorrow morning?
Write me a short poem about mountains in autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release: rank destinations, live conditions, places to stay, place search and activity list. Read-only, no login.

fr-FR.subtitle: Où kiter, surfer ou naviguer
fr-FR.description: MR. WINDS vous dit où faire du kitesurf, de la planche à voile, du wing foil, du surf ou de la voile aujourd'hui ou ce week-end : il classe les spots et marinas du monde entier selon le vent, les vagues et la météo en direct, et votre temps de trajet. Il trouve aussi où dormir avec le prix par nuit.

de-DE.subtitle: Wo kiten, surfen, segeln
de-DE.description: MR. WINDS sagt dir, wo du heute oder am Wochenende kitesurfen, windsurfen, wingfoilen, surfen oder segeln kannst: Spots und Marinas weltweit, gerankt nach Live-Wind, Wellen, Wetter und deiner Reisezeit. Dazu Unterkünfte mit Preis pro Nacht.

it-IT.subtitle: Dove fare kite, surf o vela
it-IT.description: MR. WINDS ti dice dove fare kitesurf, windsurf, wing foil, surf o vela oggi o nel weekend: classifica spot e marine in tutto il mondo in base a vento, onde e meteo in tempo reale e al tempo di viaggio. Trova anche dove dormire con il prezzo a notte.

es-ES.subtitle: Dónde hacer kite, surf o vela
es-ES.description: MR. WINDS te dice dónde hacer kitesurf, windsurf, wing foil, surf o vela hoy o este fin de semana: clasifica spots y puertos deportivos de todo el mundo según el viento, las olas y el tiempo en directo y tu tiempo de viaje. También encuentra alojamiento con precio por noche.
